Our Story

Born in Halifax,
Brewed with Love

BoBar started as a tiny pop-up at the Halifax Seaport Farmers' Market in 2019. What began as a weekend passion project — fuelled by late nights, a secondhand sealer machine, and an obsession with the perfect pearl — grew into Halifax's most-loved bubble tea destination.

2019
The Beginning

A market stall. A dream. Founder Sofia Rossi spent six months perfecting the brown sugar boba recipe before serving a single cup. The line-ups told her everything.

2021
Quinpool Calling

We opened our permanent home at 6082 Quinpool Road and never looked back. The bright yellow exterior became a Halifax landmark overnight.

2023
Community Roots

Launched our partnership with Dal and SMU campuses and started the BoBar Bursary — helping local students, one cup at a time.

Today
Still Brewing

30+ drinks, thousands of happy customers, and a team of 8 passionate boba artists. The pearls keep cooking and the love keeps flowing.
